H2_calibration.quote: Many items cut both ways. Agencies and courts often resolve ambiguity purposively, and Commerce or a markup amendment could close several gaps (e.g., #1, #19–20, #22, #25–26) before or after passage. Counsel should weigh whether any of these readings is something the company could safely rely on in operations, as opposed to something to cite in advocacy.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: It also gives developers an incentive to rush launches before enactment.
